rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Student agency — adults decide

The paired-read slide says 'The full grilling is an offer, not an obligation,' keeps the human push-back first, and supplies a value-based stop gate: stop when another answer would no longer materially sharpen the plan; if the plan is already clear, the human read is enough. This protects working memory without making the core plan read optional.
